subject: Civic Education
competence: Develops qualities that are required for a democratic life.
unique_learning_outcome: Explains qualities needed for a democratic life.
Expresses the fact that the democratic life style brings out the well-being of the society.
the_entrance: Democratic life is working as a good citizen in the society practicing democratic qualities as habits.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of democratic life and its importance.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will take notes and ask questions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student practical group activities to identify the qualities needed for a democratic life.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Small group analysis and roleplay tasks
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations and structuring findings on the benefits of democratic life.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Presenting group outcomes and comparing notes

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Consolidate learning and formative evaluation on the qualities needed for a democratic life.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles: democratic life is essential for a society's well-being.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check on the understanding of democratic life and its benefits.
post_activity: Concrete homework: write a short essay on the importance of democratic life in society.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
attachments: Worksheet: Identifying Qualities Needed for a Democratic Life
